_meta.description: Components-mode eval on a real design system: the community Figma file 'shadcn/ui components with variables & Tailwind classes' (file key eGmaKYgeO8AHj9FtE9aT5v, 135 MB, 98 component sets, ~15.5k components of which ~14.1k are icons). Registered with figma_exclude_pages ['Icons'] -> 95 candidates. The file is NOT committed (third-party, 135 MB): fetch with figma_file_key + FIGMA_ACCESS_TOKEN or save GET /v1/files/<key> and point FIGMA_EVAL_JSON at it.
_meta.grading: By PAGE (component family), not candidate name: this file often defines only sub-parts as component sets (AlertDialogHeader, DialogFooter, Table cell), so a need is right when the top pick sits on any of the listed pages. Page names are the file's own, including its typos ('Contex Menu', 'Seperator', 'Input OPT').
_meta.labeling: Authored by Claude from the file's page and component-set names and knowledge of shadcn/ui; not verified by a human.

kinds.positive: a listed page has a component candidate that should satisfy the need
kinds.none: nothing in shadcn/ui or this file matches
kinds.gap: shadcn has the component and this file has a page for it, but the page defines no component/component-set (only frames of instances), so components mode has no candidate to find -- reported separately, expected NOT found
